P.name: Z-Drive Resonance
P.title: Template:Data Ekko/Z-Drive Resonance
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Z-Drive Resonance|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Ekko
|skill        = I
|icon         = Z-Drive Resonance.png
|description  = {{sbc|Innate - Resonance:}} '''Ekko's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and damaging {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Resonance'' to enemies hit for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 3 times. The third stack consumes them all to deal {{pp|30 to 70 by 10; 80 + (140-80)/12*(x-1) for 15|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}. ''Z-Drive Resonance'' deals 270% damage against {{tip|monsters}}.
|description2 = ''Resonance'' cannot affect the same target more than once every few seconds.
|icon3        = Z-Drive Resonance 2.png
|description3 = {{sbc|Innate - Stolen Time:}} Triggering ''Resonance'' against a {{tip|champion}} grants '''Ekko''' {{pp|key=%|50 to 80 for 4|1 to 16|color=movement speed}} {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for {{pp|2 to 3 for 3|1 to 11}} seconds.
|ontargetcdstatic = {{tt|4|Begins after the stacks are consumed}}
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Enemies / Self
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = Single target
|occurrence   = On-hit
|parry        = true
|projectile   = 
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|notes        = 
* '''Ekko's''' basic attacks have different animations based on how many stacks his target has. His attack pattern is as follows: 
** {{tt|Downwards|first stack}} → {{tt|Upwards|second stack}} → {{tt|Sideways|third stack to consume all stacks}}
*** If the target has already been affected by ''Resonance'', '''Ekko's''' basic attack animations will kick or attack the target sideways.
* ''Resonance'' stacks will not be applied nor consumed if the basic attack is {{tip|dodged}} or {{tip|blocked}} or if the attack {{tip|blind|misses}}.
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Ekko|Ekko's}} {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and damaging {{tip|abilities}} apply {{tip|stacks}}, the third stack deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}. If the target was a {{tip|champion}}, this grants {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} to '''Ekko'''.
}}

W.name: Parallel Convergence
W.title: Template:Data Ekko/Parallel Convergence
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Parallel Convergence|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Ekko
|skill        = W
|icon         = false
|description  = {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Ekko's''' basic attacks deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|3% {{as|(+ 3% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''missing''' health|health}} against enemies below {{sti|health|{{as|30% of their '''maximum''' health}}}}. The damage has a minimum threshold of 15 and is capped at 150 against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.
|icon2        = Parallel Convergence.png
|description2 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ekko''' creates an afterimage of himself that, after 2 seconds, bats a device to the target location and grants {{tip|sight}} of the area for {{fd|2.5}} seconds. After travelling over {{fd|1.25}} seconds, the device expands into a chronosphere that lasts for {{fd|1.5}} seconds and which {{tip|slow|slows}} enemies within by 40%.
|description3 = If '''Ekko''' enters the sphere before it expires, it detonates to grant him a {{tip|shield}} for 2 seconds and {{tip|stun}} enemies within for {{fd|2.25}} seconds.
|leveling3    = {{st|Shield Strength|{{ap|100 to 180}} {{as|(+ 150% AP)}}}}
|description4 = ''Enemies can see the indicator for Parallel Convergence 2 seconds after casting.''
|target range = 1600
|effect radius= 375
|cooldown     = {{ap|22 to 14}}
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cost         = {{ap|30 to 50}}
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = Location
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|damagetype   = magic
|spelleffects = proc
|spellshield  = True
|occurrence   = On-hit
|projectile   = False
|parry        = true
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|outofrange   = walk to location
|notes        = 
* The passive will proc with the attack that triggers the final stack of {{ai|Z-Drive Resonance|Ekko|Resonance}} if it reduces a target's health below the 30% threshold.
* '''Ekko''' can detonate the expansion even while {{tip|untargetable}} (i.e. {{ais|Chronobreak|Ekko}} dash), but not if he is {{tip|resurrection|resurrecting}}.
* ''Parallel Convergence'' will continue to {{tip|slow}} enemies even if its expansion is detonated.
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurb        = {{sbc|Passive:}} {{cis|Ekko}} basic attacks deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} against a {{as|low-health}} target, increased based on {{as|their '''missing''' health}}.
|blurb2       = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ekko''' indicates the target location where a sphere will be created, which {{tip|slow|slows}} enemies within.
|blurb3       = If '''Ekko''' enters the sphere, it detonates, {{tip|stun|stunning}} enemies within and granting '''Ekko''' a {{sti|shield}}.
}}

E.name: Phase Dive
E.title: Template:Data Ekko/Phase Dive
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Phase Dive|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Ekko
|skill        = E
|icon         = Phase Dive.png
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ekko''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction, then empowers his next basic attack within 3 seconds to have a {{fd|0.25}}-second cast time, gain {{sti|range|300 '''bonus''' range}}, cause him to {{tip|blink}} within {{tt|125|Estimated}} range of the target, and deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
|leveling     = {{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|50 to 150}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}}}
|description2 = ''Phase Dive {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Ekko's''' basic attack timer. '''Ekko''' can cast any of his abilities during the dash.''
|target range = {{dv|{{tt|325|Dash distance}}|{{tt|550|Maximum increased dash distance across terrain}}}}
|cast time    = none
|cooldown     = {{ap|9 to 7}}
|cdstart      = post-effect
|cost         = {{ap|40 to 60}}
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = Direction
|affects      = Self
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = true
|spelleffects = Spell
|occurrence   = On-hit
|parry        = True
|projectile   = 
|grounded     = True
|knockdown    = True
|terraingrace = true
|notes        = 
* The {{tip|dash}} distance can be extended to up-to 550 units when targeting across terrain. It will only extend for the distance needed to cross the wall.
* While {{tip|ground|grounded}} or {{tip|root|rooted}}, '''Ekko''' loses the {{sti|'''bonus''' attack range}} from ''Phase Dive''.
* ''Phase Dive's'' attack can {{tip|blind|miss}} and be {{tip|blocked}} and {{tip|dodged}}, consuming the basic attack without dealing any damage.
* ''Phase Dive's'' attack {{tip|break stealth|breaks stealth}} at the start of its cast time.
** This is relevant for external sources of {{tip|stealth}} such as {{cai|Curse of the Black Mist|Senna}}.
* If the target becomes {{tip|untargetable}}, {{tip|death|dies}}, or is too far away during the empowered attack's cast time, it is cancelled but not consumed.
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Ekko}} {{tip|dash|rolls}} in the target direction, gaining {{sti|range|'''bonus''' attack range}}.
|blurb2      = His next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|blink|blinks}} him to the target and deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
}}

R.name: Chronobreak
R.title: Template:Data Ekko/Chronobreak
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Chronobreak|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Ekko
|skill        = R
|icon         = false
|description  = {{sbc|Passive:}} Upon learning ''Chronobreak'' or if its '''current''' cooldown is lower than 4 seconds, '''Ekko''' reveals a time-delayed ''afterimage'' of himself that constantly tracks where he was 4 seconds ago.
|icon2        = Chronobreak.png
|description2 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ekko''' enters {{tip|stasis (buff)|stasis}} at the start of the cast time, and afterwards {{tip|heals}} himself, increased by {{as|{{pp|label1=health lost|key=%|key1=%|type=health lost in the last 4 seconds|0 to 300 for 11|0 to 100|formula=3% per 1% of health lost in the last 4 seconds}}|health}}, and {{tip|dash|dashes}} to his ''afterimage's'' location at the time of cast over {{fd|0.5}} seconds. Upon arrival, the stasis ends and he creates an explosion that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
|leveling2    = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|200 to 500}} {{as|(+ 175% AP)}}}}{{st|Minimum Heal|{{ap|100 to 200}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}|Maximum Heal|{{ap|400 to 800}} {{as|(+ 240% AP)}}}}
|description3 = '''''Ekko''' is immune to all {{tip|airborne|displacements}} during Chronobreak.''
|effect radius= {{dv|{{tt|375|Damage radius}}|{{tt|Global|Dash to afterimage range}}}}
|cast time    = {{fd|0.5}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|110 to 50}}
|cost         = 100
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = Auto
|affects      = {{dv|Enemies|Self}}
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = spellaoe
|projectile   = 
|grounded     = True
|flavorsound  = {{sm2|Ekko_Original_R_2.ogg}} ''"Reversing polarity!"''
|knockdown    = False
|notes        = 
* '''Ekko''' will attempt to basic attack the closest target after appearing at the cast location, but can do so quicker if he manually attack commands after the dash, except if {{ai|Phase Dive|Ekko}} is primed.
* The ''afterimage's'' location will explode even if '''Ekko's''' {{tip|dash}} is interrupted.
* A ''link'' can also be seen between the ''afterimage'' and '''Ekko''' that traces along his path.
** The ''link'' follows the same visibility rules as the ''afterimage''.
** Upon activation, '''Ekko''' travels full distance through the ''link'', and thus will detonate {{ai|Parallel Convergence|Ekko}} that the ''link'' passes through.
* {{ii|Quicksilver Sash|icononly=true}} {{nie|Quicksilver}} incurs a 1-second {{sti|cooldown}} upon casting ''Chronobreak''.
* '''Ekko's''' dash cannot be interrupted by forced movement displacements since he is immune to them.
** This is not to be confused with {{tip|displacement immunity}}, which resists {{tip|airborne}} displacements plus a number of other cases. ''Chronobreak'' provides immunity only to displacements that apply {{tip|airborne}}.
|tips        =
* The ''afterimage'' instantly spawns upon learning ''Chronobreak''. This may be used once per match for a stealthy ''Chronobreak'' usage.
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurb       = {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Ekko}} reveals a time-delayed ''afterimage'' of himself that tracks where he was 4 seconds ago.
|blurb2      = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ekko''' enters {{tip|stasis}} and {{tip|dash|rewinds}} to the ''afterimage'', {{as|{{sti|healing}}}} based on the damage received in the last 4 seconds. He then explodes, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
}}
